thread:
olivia: Quick sync — Cerulean dedicated bring-up is T-6 days. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and load-test window confirmed.

sam: noted. what RPS and token/req avg should we plan for?

jia: staging metrics: median 45 req/min, 95th ~480 req/min under soak. token avg ~220. uploaded sample profile to the runbook.

maria_se: customer expects reserved 4xA100 and burst to 6 for short windows. renewal tied to meeting SLA targets.

olivia: target SLO: p95 infer <120ms on baseline, grace for 15m bursts. fallback path: switch to quantized variant if queue backs up.

sam: proposal: autoscale policy -> scale-up when queue_len > 35 for 30s, add +1 worker, max=6; scale-down after 5m stable under threshold. Also enable prefix/KV cache warmup during scale events.

jia: autoscale snippet I tested in staging:

```
policy:
  metric: queue_len
  up_threshold: 35
  up_duration: 30s
  step: 1
  max_replicas: 6
  down_duration: 300s
```

jia: note — priming script runs `priming-runner --concurrency 8 --profile cerulean-primer.json` to populate KV cache.

maria_se: Ops checklist from CS: confirm support contact, KMS key access, and warmup acceptance test results. I'll own the customer confirmation.

olivia: Load tests: can we do a progressive soak Wed 09:00 PT? plan: 10m ramp to 70% capacity, 20m soak at 100% reserved, then 15m burst to 150% (burst limited by max_replicas).

sam: scheduling Wed 09:00 PT looks good. I'll spin a dedicated cluster with reserve=4 and allow burst up to 6. Will attach load script and Grafana dashboard link.

sam: quick validation command for smoke:
```
curl -s -X POST https://redwood.dev/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"cerulean-v1","inputs":["prime"]}'
```

maria_se: I'll surface renewal risk to account team if p95 > target after soak. Also capturing customer feedback on response stability during bursts.

jia: I'll add a health-check endpoint that returns "ready" only after KV cache priming completes. That should prevent early routing to cold workers.

olivia: Action items: sam -> create dedicated pool + autoscale policy & warmup job; jia -> add priming health-check + attach primer to runbook; maria_se -> confirm customer SLA acceptance and be on call Wed; olivia -> update runbook with rollback steps and model-fallback mapping.

sam: assigned and scheduled. will post pool id and dashboard link when ready. :thumbsup:

jia: primer script and health-check PR up, linking in the thread now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to staging queued for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z. Logs and artifacts will appear in #eng-releases.

olivia: perfect. final sync Thu 08:00 PT for go/no-go. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
